Lemma
[Commutator of one covariant derivative and the Laplacian] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0243 1. ch13:13.22\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

For every covariant $\ell $-tensor $A$, \[ ( abla \Delta -\Delta abla )A \preccurlyeq n(2\ell +1)\Rm * abla A+n\ell abla \Rm *A. \]
Proof

\sketch In a normal orthonormal frame, commute $ abla _i$ past the two traced derivatives. The first interchange gives $\ell +1$ curvature actions on $ abla A$; the second gives another $\ell $ such actions and $\ell $ derivatives of curvature acting on $A$. Summing the traced index gives the stated count.

□
